name: Animated Dialog
description: An accessible Radix dialog with motion-driven enter/exit choreography (scale, slide-up, or fade) that turns into a bottom sheet on mobile and keeps its header/footer pinned while the body scrolls.
author: rmahammad
oQueDa: Dialog Radix com coreografia motion (escala/slide) e acessibilidade completa.
adaptacaoMarca: Requer @radix-ui/react-dialog (não instalado). Overlay tinta/70 com blur.
compat: React 19/Next 16/Tailwind v4: revisar 'use client', trocar framer-motion por motion/react quando aparecer; cores hardcoded → tokens do globals.css.
